# kits/tents: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Tents kit: a generic tent set for camps and caravans of many peoples. 25 culture-neutral defs (tn-<form>-<size>: ridge, bell, yurt, cone, black, marquee, round-ended, wedge, fly, awning, wagon tilt, screen) on core/engine, the Scyvoi tent toolkit read in place; eleven dresses (Scyvoi, desert and ash nomads, Beast Riders, Iziz caravaners, the Republican army, Xanadu silk, Islanders, post-apoc scrap, Eternians, generic); the role (core/camp's) and the dress are placement options; interiors from kits/interiors/sets/tents.js, flap doors on core/door; core/camp's mapping (50-camp-tents.js: tentFor, tentProgram, halt) pitches a Scyvoi band's ring and an Iziz caravan's laager on the sheet. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert, tests/test-tents.js. Read README.md

Docs: `API.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/tents.html`

Build: `cd kits/tents && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
Fragments marked **big** are over 30 KB: find the section below and read only that range.
